economic_hypothesis: A first limit-up creates a new holder-cost cohort. If the next 2-15 completed sessions absorb turnover without another limit-up, preserve the first-limit-up body midpoint, and contract volume, a later high-location volume expansion through the shelf high in a PIT bull market and healthy industry represents a second price-discovery auction after weak holders have had time to exit.
entry: first legal daily open after signal within three market sessions
failure_exit: after T+1, first completed daily close below the frozen ignition body midpoint; exit next legal open

four_binding_conditions.FIRST_LIMITUP_INFORMATION_EVENT: ignition closes at the historical price limit, exceeds the prior20 high, has no limit-up close in the prior20 completed stock sessions, and the pre-ignition prior20 return is not below -10%
four_binding_conditions.INVENTORY_LOCK_SHELF: 2-15 sessions after ignition; no intervening limit-up; shelf low >=95% of ignition body midpoint; shelf high/low range<=25%; shelf mean turnover<=1.2x ignition turnover
four_binding_conditions.PIT_BULL_AND_HEALTHY_INDUSTRY: at completed relaunch close, frozen PIT market regime BULL; industry n20>=5, median ret20>0, positive-ret20 share>50%
four_binding_conditions.RELAUNCH_AUCTION: completed close exceeds every intervening shelf high; signal return +1.5% to +8%; close location>=65%; turnover>=1.1x shelf mean
